d: In this video, Firstpost explains the growing controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, alleged Chinese spy links, and mounting US national security concerns. As Republicans push for a congressional investigation, Donald Trump continues to defend Huang. A classified Marco Rubio intelligence memo, an FBI probe, Nvidia's reported chip sales to China through Megaspeed, and Huang's controversial relationship have raised serious questions in Washington. Why did Trump downplay the intelligence warning? And why are Republicans breaking ranks with the President? Gursshheen Gahllen brings…
